title: Ethiopian Hot Pepper Chicken Wings
author: Chef Haile
desc: Ethiopian Hot Berbere Chicken Wings — chicken wings marinated in berbere, kibbeh, garlic, and lemon for 2 hours, then grilled or fried until the berbere caramelises magnificently. The Ethiopian version of hot wings — fiercer, more complex, and completely its own.
longDesc: Ethiopian berbere chicken wings are what happens when the American wing format meets Ethiopian berbere — the result is a wing of extraordinary complexity, where 15+ spice compounds caramelise on the surface during grilling.
ingredients: 1 kg chicken wings — separated at joints
steps: Mix berbere, kibbeh, garlic, lemon, mitmita, and salt into a paste.
Coat wings thoroughly. Marinate 2 hours minimum.
Grill over medium charcoal: 12—15 minutes per side.
Or oven: 200°C for 25—30 minutes, turning once.
chefTips: The berbere caramelises magnificently on the skin.
The 2-hour marination is the minimum — overnight is better.
cookingScience: See ETH064 for berbere crust science.
sustainabilityTips: Ethiopian chicken wings — using secondary cuts.
storage: Best eaten immediately. Marinate up to 24 hours.
culturalNote: Ethiopian berbere wings are the modern Ethiopian bar and restaurant scene's most popular snack — the intense berbere heat combined with the fat of the chicken skin makes them one of the most satisfying snacks in the Ethiopian food repertoire.
